summary: At segment 0, step 76, polymorphed hero combat reaches uhitm.c:gulpum() and then mhitm.c:xdrainenergym(). The kobold shaman has a magic attack and has mspec_used below 20, so C adds d(2,2), updates mspec_used, and prints the lethargy message. JavaScript draws the preceding 1-in-4 check, then replaces xdrainenergym() with note_unported(), which omits that draw, state update, and message. Full caller wiring also reaches uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_dren() through the AD_DREN arm of mhitm_adtyping(); B currently reserves that dispatcher, so this implementation must wait until B releases the source scope.

source.branch: mhitm.c:xdrainenergym() runs only when the target monster has mspec_used < 20 and has an AT_MAGC or AT_BREA attack. It adds d(2,2) to mspec_used and, when givemsg is true, calls pline_mon() with “seems lethargic.” C calls this helper directly from uhitm.c:gulpum() for an engulfing AD_DREN attack and from uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_dren() for hero-versus-monster and monster-versus-monster AD_DREN dispatch. The selected case reaches the gulpum() call; the mhitm_ad_dren() calls are routed through uhitm.c:mhitm_adtyping().
callers: uhitm.c:gulpum() (around line 5176) calls xdrainenergym(mdef, TRUE) after its AD_DREN 1-in-4 check. hmonas() selects gulpum() for the energy vortex AT_ENGL attack (around line 5769). The current JavaScript owner is uhitm.js:gulpum(), whose AD_DREN branch draws rn2(4) and then calls note_unported("mhitm.c xdrainenergym").

uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_dren() calls xdrainenergym() in its hero-attacker and monster-attacker branches (around lines 2427 and 2438). uhitm.c:mhitm_adtyping() dispatches AD_DREN to mhitm_ad_dren() (around line 4808); the corresponding JavaScript AD_DREN arm remains unported at uhitm.js around line 7390. B reserves source:uhitm.c:mhitm_adtyping for its active Pestilence task, so this caller cannot be wired by A2 until that reservation is released.

uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_dren() depends on the existing JavaScript mhitm_mgc_atk_negated() and trap.c:drain_en() implementations.
Complete xdrainenergym caller wiring requires the AD_DREN arm of uhitm.c:mhitm_adtyping(); B currently reserves that whole source function.
